errors.text_span: The pie chart compares the proportion of projects that have completed inspections, are under site inspection completion, are under design completion, and those that do not meet the city inspection standards.
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is incorrectly described. The figure shows the level of preparation and qualification of contractors and designers for Passive House standard projects, not project inspection statuses.

errors.text_span: 51% of projects have completed inspections, 23% are under site inspection completion, another 23% are under design completion, and 3% do not meet the city inspection standards.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the sectors to project inspection statuses instead of the actual categories related to qualification levels for Passive House standard projects.
The 51% sector (green) is incorrectly labeled as 'completed inspections' instead of 'Няма достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти за изграждането на сграда според стандарта Пасивна къща.'

The 23% sector (red) is incorrectly labeled as 'under site inspection completion' instead of 'Само част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда.'

The 23% sector (purple) is incorrectly labeled as 'under design completion' instead of 'Само малка част от изпълнителите/проектантите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда, а голям брой специалисти имат нужда от обучения за изпълнението на стандарта.'

errors.text_span: 3% do not meet the city inspection standards
errors.evidence: The 3% sector (blue) is incorrectly labeled as 'do not meet the city inspection standards' instead of 'Подготвени и добре квалифицирани са за да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда.'

errors.text_span: The remaining 77% of projects are under site inspection completion.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly aggregates percentages (23% + 23% + 31% hallucinated) and introduces a non-existent claim about 77% of projects.
The description does not mention the legend or the percentage labels inside the sectors.
The description does not mention that the sectors are not ordered in any noticeable way.
The description omits the actual purpose of the chart, which is to show the level of preparation and qualification of contractors and designers for Passive House standard projects.
